title: Owner: choose where the off-host copy goes
goal: The owner picks the destination for the off-host copy
acceptance: The owner chooses one option (another machine on the network via a file share, a cloud bucket, or nerv:F-062's off-host mechanism); the choice is recorded here with the date
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: The choice is recorded on F-026
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One decision; the options page is written by T01. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
